## Mathematical target

Paper theorem/lemma and exact source revision (or infrastructure-only):

## Statement fidelity

- [ ] All hypotheses and quantifier order match the paper
- [ ] Uniformity in Q, B and all auxiliary constants is documented
- [ ] Degree drops, exact zeros, multiplicities and boundary cases are retained
- [ ] No theorem-equivalent premise or extra hypothesis was introduced

## Reproducibility

- [ ] `bash scripts/check.sh` passes
- [ ] Principal new declarations added to `scripts/Audit.lean`
- [ ] `#print axioms` outputs examined
- [ ] Source-to-Lean statement comparison independently reviewed
- [ ] Proof commit SHA recorded in `docs/STATUS.md`

## Publication safety

- [ ] No unpublished manuscript or private audit was added to the public repository
- [ ] No old MahlerLean proof or git history was copied unnecessarily
